title: 第546章 家里人第545章 进击的宾客
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
第546章“家里人”
卡斯特兰伯爵借力跃起，越过护栏。
双脚还没落地，手中长剑已经向前斩出。
剑锋直取站在女神投影下方的半兽人。
那个将勒拿九头蛇毒血泼向女神投影，也是整场袭击中唯一主动撕去伪装的半兽人。
半兽人没有拔出武器。
他甚至没有躲。
只是在长剑即将落下时，抬起双手。
十根手指迅速弯曲。
指甲以肉眼可见的速度拉长，化作一双漆黑利爪。
“铛！”
长剑被双爪稳稳接住。
剑锋卡在交错爪刃之间。
刺目火星从指缝中连续迸出，落在半兽人的脸上，又迅速熄灭。
爪刃表面还有一层细密纹路。
卡斯特兰伯爵手臂发力。
剑身向下压出半寸。
地面却在半兽人脚下率先开裂。
白色石砖发出“咔咔”声响。
裂纹向四周飞快扩散。

半兽人依旧没有后退。
“龙喉！”
卡斯特兰伯爵看清对方，脸色猛地沉下去。
“你知道自己在做什么吗！”
被称为龙喉的半兽人慢慢抬起头。
最先映入眼帘的，是他的左眼。
那只眼睛没有瞳孔。
只剩下一片浑浊的灰白。
一道焦黑伤疤从左侧眉骨向下延伸。
穿过眼睛。
一路落到下颌。
几乎将整张脸从中间劈成两半。
龙喉的右眼却亮得惊人。
暗金色瞳孔竖成一条细线。
那只眼睛越过交错的剑锋与利爪，冷冷看向卡斯特兰伯爵。
“我当然知道。”
龙喉嘴角缓缓咧开。
突出嘴唇的獠牙随之露出。
“我比任何人都清楚。”
话音落下。

龙喉体内响起一连串沉闷骨骼摩擦声。
他的肩膀开始抬高。
content_en:
Chapter 546 "Family"
Count Castellan used the force to jump up and over the guardrail.
Before his feet even hit the ground, the sword in his hand was already slashing forward.
The sword pointed directly at the orc standing under the goddess's projection.
The orc who poured the venomous blood of Lena's Hydra onto the goddess's projection was also the only half-orc who took the initiative to tear off his disguise during the entire attack.
The orc did not draw his weapon.
He didn't even hide.
Just when the sword was about to fall, he raised his hands.
Ten fingers bent quickly.
The nails lengthened at a speed visible to the naked eye, turning into a pair of pitch black claws.
"Cang!"
The long sword was firmly caught by both claws.
The blade of the sword was stuck between the staggered claw blades.
Dazzling sparks burst out from the fingers, landed on the orc's face, and then quickly extinguished.
There is also a layer of fine texture on the surface of the claw blade.
Count Castellan exerted his strength in his arms.
The sword blade was pressed down half an inch.
But the ground cracked first under the orcs' feet.
The white stone bricks made a "click" sound.
The cracks spread rapidly around.
The orc still didn't retreat.
"Dragon Throat!"
Count Castellan saw the other party clearly, and his face suddenly darkened.
"Do you know what you are doing!"
The orc known as Dragonmaw slowly raised his head.
The first thing that caught his eye was his left eye.
That eye has no pupil.
Only a murky gray remains.
A black scar extends downward from the left eyebrow bone.
through the eyes.
All the way down to the jaw.
Almost split the entire face in half in the middle.
Dragon Throat's right eye was astonishingly bright.
The dark golden pupils formed a thin line.
That eye looked coldly at Count Castellan across the intertwined sword blades and sharp claws.
"Of course I know."
Long Miao's mouth slowly opened.
The fangs protruding from his lips were exposed.
"I know better than anyone."
The words fell.
A series of dull bone friction sounds sounded in Longmiao's body.
His shoulders began to rise.
